title: Big Sister’s Whereabouts
paragraphs: After arriving in Melromarc through the portal, we insisted on meeting with the Queen despite it being late at night.
“…Iwatani-sama and Kitamura-sama, what brings you here at this late hour?”
It’s understandable that the Queen looked a little drowsy. Considering the time, of course.
“I apologize for the late hour. I thought we could ask the castle staff, but…”
“That’s right. When it comes to an audience with Iwatani-sama, I had arranged for them to go through me first, so there’s no problem.”
Father kept bowing his head repeatedly. Is there any need for such deference toward the Queen?
“So, what brings you here tonight? I have a feeling that, just like Kawasumi-sama, Kitamura-sama came after hearing something, correct?”
“Ah… yes. Actually—”
Father explained to the Queen what I had just told him. Mainly about the villagers from the first world.
“I thought I had seen her somewhere before… So, she was one of Father’s subjects.”
Éclair said this while looking at Older Sister. It seemed like she had something she wanted to say to her.
“Why didn’t you say anything sooner?”
“Oh my, even if you’re the lord’s daughter, with how chaotic Melromarc was, you didn’t seem to be acting like your father. I felt bad, you know?”
Older Sister replied nonchalantly, as if nothing had happened. And to top it off, she transformed into her beast form to confirm it for Éclair.
“So, you couldn’t trust me…”
“Oh my?” Éclair murmured as if giving up.
Older Sister waved her hand as if to deny it, but to me, it looked more like an affirmation.
“In other words, you want to protect the demi-human slaves in our country, is that correct?”
“That’s right.”
Father nodded at the Queen’s words.
“The timing is just right. I’ve heard that slave traders do most of their business at night.”
“Well, it’s a profession that thrives away from the public eye. So, could we use your connections, Queen?”
“Please wait a moment.”
The Queen seemed to be giving various orders to her subordinates. I’m sure the matter will be resolved soon.

“Given the damage caused by the Three Hero Church and the lingering influence of my daughter’s specter, I can’t guarantee that we’ll find the people you’re looking for, but I will have my people make arrangements.”
“That’s a great help.”

And so, Father, the others, and I followed the guide arranged by the Queen to visit the slave traders’ guild located in the castle town. Older Sister handed over a list where she had meticulously written down the names and races of the villagers.
“Hmm… Slaves from that village in Seatto, huh? If they’ve been traded, it’ll require a tracking investigation, which might take some time.”

However, that day ended with the slave traders merely agreeing to search for them. Apparently, many of the transactions were done without names, using symbols instead. They should implement a registration system like they do with weapons and armor. Moreover, there seem to be quite a few of the Racoon species, the same as Older Sister, which makes it difficult to pinpoint the exact ones. In that sense, it feels like a miracle that Keel was successfully retrieved through the monster merchant. Or rather, doesn’t that mean that monster merchant was actually quite capable?
“Yes, yes. A direct request from the Hero. Yes.”
“Y-Yeah… thank you.”

Father looked a bit wary. It brings back memories of the previous loop. Then, he whispered softly into my ear, saying that this person seemed like the Pope of the Four Heroes Church. So, he thinks the same? It’s definitely likely that they are distantly related.
“By the way, Father. In the first world, the person you often talked to was this monster merchant.”
“Really? Then maybe it’s likely I bought from him.”

Father nodded at my words and asked the monster merchant. Oh? Has he not met this guy before? Well… come to think of it, there doesn’t seem to have been an opportunity to meet this time. But I did hear that he bought Filo-tan’s egg in Melromarc.
“Um, so I’m looking for a child named Raphtalia and another named Keel…”
“Yes. All the slave traders in Melromarc are conducting a full-scale investigation. Yes.”
“Ah, I see…”

They sure move fast. And so, the search for the sister and the villagers began. With the Queen’s backing, the slave traders searched for the villagers desperately. If they found them, they’d probably sell them for a high price.

The slave traders even contacted their noble patrons to search, but apparently, a large number of fakes were gathered. For about three days starting from the next day, Father and Older Sister would go to the slave traders regularly, only to return completely drained.
“They say people are resilient, but I’m speechless at how these merchants try to pass off fakes even when they know we’re looking for people we know.”
“Shall we kill them as an example?”
“Why does it always have to go straight to killing? And… I’d love to buy and help those slaves, but if I start doing that, there’ll be no end to it. It’s really a tough situation.”
“I’m sorry, Naofumi-chan.”

Father shook his head at the words of Older Sister. That’s right. There’s no need for Older Sister to apologize. The blame lies entirely with the useless merchants bringing in fakes. Should we just kill them after all?
“It’s fine, it’s fine. This is something I wanted to do, and they’re the people Sadeena wants to protect.”
“Thank you, Naofumi-chan.”
Older Sister looked genuinely grateful. Meanwhile, Father’s expression remained gloomy.
“Father, you don’t look so well.”
“W-Well, yeah. How should I put it… that incident where the princess turned into a vengeful spirit caused a lot of casualties. It didn’t matter if they were demi-humans, humans, or even nobles.”
What…? This feels unpleasant. Is that incident still casting its shadow here? Nearly half of Melromarc’s territory was affected. That Crimson Swine is nothing but a plague on this world.

As things progressed, they started finding some of the village slaves… but only about a quarter of the ones I remember from the village have been found. Even Keel, who should have been easy to locate, has left no trace. It seems they’ve been traded in a lot of different places.
“We might have to extend the search range to neighboring countries. It seems a lot of slave traders moved around before that incident.”
“The search seems to be struggling.”

By the way, Ren, Itsuki, and the panda apparently found Fohl fairly quickly. They also found his sister with him, which is a relief. But Father hasn’t gone to see them because he doesn’t really want to get too close.
Is the trauma from that homo suspicion still haunting him? And so, as the fourth day was about to pass…
“Um… the investigation into the person named Raphtalia, whom the Shield Hero was searching for, has been concluded. Yes.”

The monster merchant answered while wiping his sweat. Judging by the atmosphere, Father seems to have a bad feeling and is trembling slightly. Even Older Sister, who is usually so cheerful, had a very serious expression as she stared at the monster merchant.
“I-I see. W-Well, can you tell us?”
“Yes.”
The monster merchant spread out some documents and began explaining.
“After that, the noble who bought her whipped her, and her condition quickly worsened…”
